Hi! I'm **Olivia Jackson Lambert**, a data scientist and engineer. I enjoy building systems that support decision making and strategy.

When I’m not working, I’m usually kayaking, reading, making art, or hanging out with my husband and three cats.

If you'd like to read more about what I'm up to, check out my monthly reflections [here](/reflections/reflections.html).

## Highlights

```{=html}
<div class="card-grid">
  <div class="card">
    <h4>Time-series forecasting </h4>
    <p>Built a global product demand forecasting pipeline using Python, prophet and SQL, delivering 10K+ consumer goods forecasts every month to teams on 5 continents.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>Reliable pipelines</h4>
    <p>Released scores generated from advanced machine learning models at the Democratic National Committee to 100K+ monthly users for 160+ million voters.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>Autonomous devices</h4>
    <p>Implemented OpenCV to analyze live cloud cover over forests in Oxford with autonomous devices, improving satellite re-entry over forested areas. </p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>Computer vision</h4>
    <p>Analyzed 100s of images of Type 1a supernovae from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey, applying computer vision algorithms to study the local environment. </p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>Machine learning</h4>
    <p>Designed an algorithm to predict the hydration states of magnesium sulphate salts based from Raman spectra for use in future planetary exploration vehicles. </p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>Statistical methods</h4>
    <p>Applied statistical methods to explore the feasability and scientific value of Mars sample return missions, modeling different sampling approaches.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
